title: Probar /wc auto-reponiendo trabajo sin /g
mission: Independently verify the current public /wc bootstrap + METABOLISM_POLICY_V1 as an end-to-end self-replenishing canary. Prove that generic workers can observe a thin/imbalanced frontier, converge on deterministic guide work without per-worker variants, materialize grounded successors, and continue into one successor without requiring a privileged /g chat. Repair software-solvable defects with CAS and leave exact receipts.
definition_of_done: The public /wc entry loads main/wc, GUIDE_SWARM_PROTOCOL_V1 and METABOLISM_POLICY_V1 before allocation.
A concrete metabolism trigger is derived from durable state using exact evidence, not asserted by prose.
If no matching guide job already exists, two independent contenders would deterministically derive the same role+evidence fingerprint/path; no worker-specific timestamp/random/chat salt is used.
Exactly one shared guide-derived job is materialized or an already-existing equivalent is reused; create-exists/collision does not create a variant.
The guide cycle leaves durable material output: consumed returns, mechanism repair, and/or 1-7 grounded successor jobs. Analysis-only output is not accepted.
After guide RETURN, a worker reloads and claims/executes at least one grounded successor or records an exact safety/authority boundary proving why it cannot.
No manual /g routing/result transport occurs between guide work and successor execution.
The verifier distinguishes useful consumed successor growth from raw task-count inflation and does not claim exponential growth until consecutive productive generations exist.
Any software-solvable defect found in bootstrap/policy/allocation is patched with CAS and re-verified.
